call_points.text: FY27 EBITDA/tonne maintained at ₹500-550; volume guidance at 7 million tons excluding clinker sales.
No major Capex plans beyond maintenance for next two years; focus on debt reduction and land sale.
South India is key demand driver; AP/Telangana grew 11% YoY in Q1, Karnataka flat.
Q1FY27 EBITDA/tonne at ₹451; expects ₹100/tonne cost inflation offset by new capacity.
Gross debt at ₹1,704 Cr; expects ₹150 Cr from Vizag land sale in FY27.
Q2 seasonally challenging due to rains and maintenance shutdowns; expects to recover in Q3/Q4.

operating_notes.text: Power and fuel cost stood at ₹1,484 per tonne in Q1FY27, up from ₹1,450 per tonne in Q1FY26.
Freight cost stood at ₹858 per tonne in Q1FY27, stable compared to ₹860 per tonne in Q1FY26.
Mattampally plant operated at 65% utilisation, Gudipadu at 79%, Bayyavaram at 67%, Jeerabad at 96%, Jajpur at 50%, and Dachepalli at 42% during Q1FY27.
